name: Old School Hard Trance
lineage: Old school hard trance revisits the driving trance records of the 1990s and their continuing life in DJ sets, collector communities and revival releases. Noom and related European rave catalogues connect hard kicks, acid-tinged sequences and emphatic melodic hooks with the energy of early hard dance.
